title: Kenneth Walker III is a Chiefs star. Why didn't the Seahawks try to keep him?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kenneth Walker III is a Chiefs star. Why didn't the Seahawks try to keep him?
sources.description: Kansas City Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker III was "not close" to re-signing with the Seattle Seahawks after winning Super Bowl 60 MVP with the team. Here's why.
